faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Have another question? You are welcome to get in touch.

items.q: Can I get support in Japanese?
items.a: Yes, you are welcome to ask for support in Japanese.

items.q: Can you also help in German or English?
items.a: Yes, enquiries in German and English are also welcome.
Tell us your location and needs, and we can discuss whether a visit is possible.
Depending on the issue, online support may be an option to discuss.

items.q: Can you help me choose a PC?
items.a: We can discuss device choices based on your needs and setup after purchase.

items.q: Can you advise me about internet contracts?
items.a: You can ask about providers, contracts and help with enquiries in German.
After clarifying the scope and time involved, we provide an individual estimate before work starts.

items.q: Do you support areas outside Düsseldorf?
items.a: Enquiries from nearby areas are welcome. Contact us to discuss the options.
